collection_title: The Collection of the late James C. Risk, C.V.O., F.S.A.
original_description: The Royal Victorian Order, G.C.V.O., Dame Grand Cross, breast star, silver, gilt and enamels, the body set with paste brilliants, 90mm diameter, the reverse with gold retaining pin and additional silver prongs, in Collingwood, London, fitted case, extremely fine.
headline_claim: Described by the auction as the jewelled GCVO star given by King Edward VIII to Queen Mary on her admission to the Order in 1936.
footnote_summary: Order date stated as 23 June 1936; accompanied by period news clipping, a photograph, explanatory notes attributed to Queen Mary, and related clippings.
saleroom_notice: Auction notice states the Royal Collection holds Queen Mary’s original GCVO star set with white sapphires; a star set with paste stones is not in the Royal Collection records as official insignia. Without further documented provenance, attribution of this lot as worn by Queen Mary cannot be positively established.
evidence_summary: Full object-page body returned within web search result; direct object-page open was not performed. Treat attribution cautiously: saleroom notice explicitly says it cannot be positively established.
image_status: No image URL in returned page text; no file downloaded, decoded or visually reviewed.
